# ZexNote
A concise and elegant local note-taking APP, developed based on Flutter + Material3

## ✨ Software Features
- Theme: Automatically switch with system light/dark night mode; Android 12+ supports Material You wallpaper dynamic color picking
- Bottom small floating capsule navigation bar with smooth slide indicator animation for page switching
- Fully local note storage with basic note-taking functions: create, edit, delete, archive notes
- Support for batch operations on notes (multi-select batch delete, batch archive)
- Note JSON backup and recovery for convenient data export and import

## 📱 Device Support
- CPU Architecture: **ARM64 only (arm64-v8a)**, does not support 32-bit ARM or x86 architecture
- Android Version: Android 9.0 (API 28) and above (compatible with Android 9–16)

## 🔄 Dual-Channel Version Update System
1. **Dual-Channel Version Detection**: Prioritizes GitHub Releases API; automatically switches to Releases Atom feed when hitting IP rate limits to avoid access frequency control
2. Optional Mirror Sauce high-speed download source; Mirror Sauce project page can only be opened via browser; automatically falls back to direct GitHub connection on interface errors
3. In-app APK downloads use only direct GitHub connection with smooth progress bar, displaying real-time downloaded/total file size
4. Update dialog has a built-in scrollable log window recording the entire download process
5. Update dialog options: Download in Browser | Later | Retry, with built-in upgrade icon
6. Settings page "About" section:
   - Switch: Auto-check for updates on startup
   - Button: Manually check for new version
7. Security Verification: Verify APK signature after in-app download completion; block installation if signature mismatch to prevent malicious tampering

## 📦 Build Instructions
- Use GitHub Actions for remote cloud compilation and packaging of APK
- Cloud automatically signs with JKS key and outputs signed APK
- On successful build, automatically publishes GitHub Release and marks as Latest version
- Users can install directly after download without manual signing; new versions can upgrade by overwriting

## 🎨 Application Icon
- Source icon file: `assets/images/app_icon.png`
- Desktop icon requires generating full set of mipmap sizes and replacing icon files in the `android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/` directory

## 📱 Permission Description
- `INTERNET`: Used for version detection and downloading update packages
- Storage Permission: Save downloaded APK and note backup files
- `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES`: Invoke system installer after download completion

## ⚠️ Usage Notes
1. This software is a local note-taking tool; all notes are saved locally on the phone by default and regular backup is recommended
2. Each time a new version is released, **synchronously update the version number in two locations**
   - version in `pubspec.yaml`
   - `currentVersion` in `lib/main.dart`

# Terraria Wiki Offline

An application built with .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid that provides a fast, offline Terraria Wiki browsing experience.

[BigBearK's Personal Space - BigBearK Personal Homepage - Bilibili Video](https://space.bilibili.com/470138112)

## Core Features

### 1. Offline Browsing

- **Local Access**: Text, images, audio and video data are all stored locally and can be accessed without an internet connection.
- **Web Typography**: Uses built-in local web server and Iframe rendering to preserve the official Wiki's layout and styling.
- **Page Navigation**: Implements refresh-free page navigation within the app by intercepting internal links.
- **Image Viewer**: Includes an image viewer that displays the full-size image when clicked.

### 2. Search and Indexing

- **Real-time Search**: The top search bar provides keyword matching based on the local SQLite database, with a dropdown panel for entry preview. Also supports matching keywords for other list pages.
- **Page List**: Provides an **All Pages** overview view containing all pages in the database.

### 3. History and Bookmarks

- **Browsing History**: Records the user's page access history.
- **Bookmarks**: Supports bookmarking specific pages, with bookmark data saved in the local SQLite database.

### 4. Data Package Management

- **Online Download**: Uses a crawler on the **Data Management** page to fetch the page list, supports downloading all or only text data, with logs displayed in the output panel below.

  **(It is recommended to import data packages from settings, as downloading data through the official website is very time-consuming and can take more than 5 hours.)**

- **Page Updates**: Recommended, the program automatically fetches pages that need updating from the official website, much faster than downloading all pages.

- **Resource Management**: You can download image resources anytime when you only have text data, and you can easily delete resource data or the entire database to free up space.

- **Status Display**: You can view the storage space used by the data package, the number of pages, resources, update time, etc.

- **Multiple Wiki Management (Future Support)**: May support wikis for mods like Calamity in the future.

### 5. Settings

- **Theme Switching**: Supports light and dark modes, can automatically switch with system settings or be manually specified.
- **Search Settings**: Supports customizing the maximum search count, but setting it too high may affect performance.
- **Download Settings**: Supports customizing the number of download threads, but excessive frequency may cause the server to refuse access, modification is not recommended.
- **Data Import/Export**: Recommended feature, one-click import is very convenient.

Cattafish/QQNT-Patcher.body:
# QQNT-Patcher

Master, hello meow! Welcome to QQNT-Patcher~ This is a small tool specifically designed for static patching and dynamic extension of Android QQNT, it can run directly without Root and without relying on any Xposed / LSPosed framework, meow!

- Telegram Channel: [ZcraftMod](https://t.me/ZcraftMod)
- GitHub Repository: [Cattafish/QQNT-Patcher](https://github.com/Cattafish/QQNT-Patcher)

---

## Project Introduction

QQNT-Patcher is an automated static bytecode patching and runtime extension tool for Android QQNT architecture. By directly performing pure in-memory streaming AST local reconstruction on target Dex files from the official package, coordinating in-situ patching of underlying Native signature verification instructions, appending independent extension Dex, and with a built-in modern dynamic Java script engine, it achieves framework-free, Root-free ultimate feature enhancement.

### Why Use Static Patching
1. **Evades Framework Feature Detection**: Core modifications are directly solidified in Dex bytecode and Native instructions, runtime execution is consistent with official native code flow, eliminating Xposed / LSPosed framework stack and feature detection.
2. **Underlying Native Signature Verification Bypass**: For arm64-v8a underlying `libcodecwrapperV2.so` performs precise instruction-level aligned replacement (in-situ Bypass signature verification jump), fundamentally avoiding signature verification anomalies.
3. **Complete Closed-loop Pure In-Memory AST Streaming Reconstruction**: Connects Smali underlying ANTLR lexical/syntax analyzer with Dexlib2 `MemoryDataStore` pipeline, completes AST traversal and bytecode assembly in JVM heap memory in real-time, zero temporary files written to disk throughout, eliminating flash wear and multi-threaded I/O contention.
4. **Dual Fine-grained Incremental Caching Mechanism**:
   - **Rule Derivation Level Caching**: Based on rule module source code hash awareness of changes, unmodified rule derivations directly reuse in 0 seconds.
   - **Dex Subpackage Level Caching**: Based on original Dex content and hit rule combination to calculate hash, unaffected subpackages completely skip decompilation and reconstruction, secondary builds only consume packaging and signature time.
5. **Standardized Pure Compilation Chain**: Engineering access to standard Android SDK compilation stub library (`android.jar`), preventing generated DEX from being polluted by redundant system classes, guaranteeing running stability from the source.
6. **Dynamic Script Ecosystem Extension**: Built-in modern BeanShell 3 runtime and native SSO protocol packet transmission pipeline, fully compatible with QFun ecosystem dynamic Java scripts.
7. **4-Byte Page Alignment**: Build chain automatically executes `zipalign` 4-byte alignment, deeply optimizing cold startup loading efficiency and memory usage on Android 11~15 systems.

# Passwall Sub Panel

A pluggable multi-user subscription management panel for 3X-UI/S-UI that dynamically renders Clash/Mihomo, sing-box, and V2rayN subscriptions

---

## Introduction

Passwall Sub Panel is a proxy subscription management system built with Go + React. Through pluggable adapters, it integrates with [3X-UI](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui) and [S-UI](https://github.com/alireza0/s-ui), providing complete user management, subscription generation, traffic monitoring, as well as SSO single sign-on (SAML / OIDC), local login with 2FA / Passkey, operation audit, multiple databases (SQLite / MySQL / PostgreSQL), and non-root operation capabilities.

**Applicable scenarios**: From personal/friend groups and small teams to large and medium-sized organizations requiring single sign-on, operation audit, compliance traceability, and non-root deployment — a single-file binary can cover all scenarios with features enabled as needed.

**Deployment form**: Single-file Go binary (frontend SPA embedded via `go:embed`), can be launched directly with `./psp`, and Docker images are also provided.

### Versions and Upgrade Paths

- **V3 Final Stable**: [v3.9.2](https://github.com/KazuhaHub/Passwall-Sub-Panel/releases/tag/v3.9.2), sharing the final V3 database baseline with `v3.9.2-beta.20`.
- **V4 Beta**: [v4.0.0-beta.2](https://github.com/KazuhaHub/Passwall-Sub-Panel/releases/tag/v4.0.0-beta.2), includes Passwall Node installation wizard and historical migration convergence; existing beta1 tags and images remain unchanged.
- **V3→V4 Upgrade**: [V4 Upgrade Guide](https://github.com/KazuhaHub/Passwall-Sub-Panel/blob/HEAD/docs/UPGRADE-v4.md). V4 performs automatic migration on normal startup; do not run `psp migrate`. Before using subsequent migration convergence versions, first successfully start the final V3, and back up the database, configuration, and original keys.
- **V2→V3 Historical Migration**: [V3 Database Reconstruction Manual](https://github.com/KazuhaHub/Passwall-Sub-Panel/blob/HEAD/docs/UPGRADE-v3.0.0.md), use only frozen V3 tools; V4 does not support direct V2 database import.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# 🪪 Hong Kong Immigration Department Appointment Quota Monitoring

Real-time tracking of Hong Kong Immigration Department **ID card replacement** appointment quotas, with automatic notifications via **Feishu groups + Feishu private messages** when new quotas are released.

---

## 📱 Method One: Join Feishu Group (Recommended)

The bot automatically pushes quota changes with **instant delivery**, join the group and use immediately, no configuration needed.

> 📖 **[Group Info & How to Join](https://scn7uo58gnuo.feishu.cn/wiki/QSFlwcMBmil7sGkZRBTcAWqwnCf)** (Multiple group solutions, automatic distribution when full)

### 💬 Method Two: Feishu Private Message Subscription

If you don't want to join a group, you can also **filter by date** and only receive notifications for the dates you're interested in:

1. [Private message the bot "HKID Quota Auto-Monitoring"](https://applink.feishu.cn/T98uc8RbxI8c) (Trigger by sending any message)
2. The bot will reply with an interactive card supporting:
   - 📅 **Subscribe to Specific Dates** — Only get notifications for your appointment date
   - 🔔 **Subscribe to All Dates** — Get notified for all quota releases
   - 📊 **View / Edit / Cancel Subscription**
3. You can also reply directly with dates for one-click subscription, e.g. `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Three filtering modes are supported:
- 📅 **By Date** — Only specific dates, unlimited offices
- 🏢 **By Office** — Only specific offices, unlimited dates
- 🎯 **By Date + Office** — Exact match

> 💡 The bot private chat has a 1-2 second delay. If you're in a hurry, joining the group is recommended.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status for all offices across Hong Kong
- 📈 Quota release pattern heatmap, visualize release frequency by time period
- 📖 Includes phone appointment guide
- 🔧 Built-in admin dashboard supporting subscriber management, statistics overview, dual-channel broadcasts

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quotas are detected, they are pushed in the following order:

> **Group Chat Broadcast** (Multiple groups in parallel) → **Private Message DM** (Parallel, only push to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu groups and private messages arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy & Security

- Feishu user data is **AES-256-GCM encrypted** and not readable in the repository
- Only read **publicly released** quota data from Immigration Department

alicewe1/alice-assistant.body: # Alice Assistant **Agent client management assistant** Portable desktop tool: decouples prompts, skill libraries, and clients from each other, allowing any combination and deployment to any Agent. [English](https://github.com/alicewe1/alice-assistant/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · **Simplified Chinese** --- ## What is this Alice Assistant is a portable desktop tool for Windows designed to manage **prompts** and **skill libraries** for AI coding Agents. It decouples prompts, skill libraries, and clients: any prompt can be paired with any skill library and deployed to any client. To switch to a different combination, just click in the interface—no need to manually navigate directories or copy-paste files. **It doesn't restrict clients.** It comes with presets for common Agents, while also allowing you to specify custom paths—select a prompt file, a skill folder, and a target folder to integrate a new client. The entire runtime (including the built-in portable Codex) is distributed with the package and can be used directly on any Windows machine: no registry writes, no system environment pollution, uninstall by simply deleting the folder. --- ## Interface *Overview — see all client integration statuses at a glance* *Workflow — select client → select preset group → confirm prompts and skills → inject with one click* Each of the 6 functional pages has a **usage tutorial** in the top-right corner: when activated, the screen dims, the relevant elements are highlighted with cutouts, and bubble tooltips explain what each step does as you progress through the page. Below is the effect of step 1 of the tutorial: *Beginner tutorial — cutout highlighting + directional arrows + step-by-step explanations, with support for skip / previous / next* --- ## Core Capabilities | Capability | Description | |---|---| | **Prompt Management** | Prompts are stored as real files on disk, with the interface reading directly from disk; can reference built-in resource libraries or point to any local file | | **Skill Library Management** | Skills are managed as packages and synced to the target client's skill directory upon installation; automatically identifies three types: `simple` / `tree` / `router`, with full-tree copying to preserve sub-skills and relative references | | **Free Combination** | Any combination of prompts × skill libraries × clients. # Genshin Impact University Alliance

Welcome to the Genshin Impact University Alliance project! This project aims to collect and organize a list of Genshin Impact-related universities across the country (currently 308 universities, of which 75 are valid), providing a campus gathering place.

Non-universities can also be added~

If you like this project, you can give it a star on [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University).
**This list prioritizes displaying valid domains, sorted alphabetically by school name within the same validity group**

:::caution
**You must purchase a domain from a cloud provider, configure its DNS resolution and redirect, and test that it can be accessed normally in a browser before it can be listed on this site, otherwise it cannot be added to this site**
:::
1. **Enter the Project**: Click [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University) in the upper right corner
2. **Fork this Repository**: Find and click the "Fork" button in the upper right corner of the page to copy this project to your GitHub account.
3. **Clone Repository**: Clone the repository you just forked to your local computer.
4. **Create a New Branch**: Create a new branch based on the modifications you want to make.
5. **Add Domain**: In the new folder in your branch, add your domain following the instructions in the README there.
6. **Submit Pull Request**: Submit a Pull Request on GitHub to merge your modifications into the original repository. Before submitting a Pull Request, ensure that your modifications are accurate and have been tested.
7. **For those unfamiliar with GitHub operations, directly fill out the form to submit information [Genshin Impact University Information Collection](https://wj.qq.com/s2/14161038/95a1/), and make sure you have registered the domain and set up the redirect**

danything/denpa.body:
# denpa **A home TV recording server that works right away just by inserting a tuner and starting it up.** You don't write a single line of configuration file. The tuner distinguishes between types (terrestrial / satellite) by itself, and PX-Q3U4 and the like don't even need drivers on the host (bundled with the agent image). After that, just press scan on the tuner screen. There's no need to set up Mirakurun or EDCB separately and connect them, and yet you can change anything you want to modify from the screen. Reservations are made with just a press from the program guide. Commercials are skipped automatically, and you can watch both live and recordings in the browser with subtitles and data broadcasting. You can also send it to VLC on your TV, or download it and watch it in your favorite player. You don't need to set up a media server.


Reservations and Recording — with thumbnails. Press to watch right away
Live — with subtitles and data broadcasting. Pause to catch up
Watch — subtitles as broadcast, commercials are skipped automatically
**A list of screens is at [docs/screens.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/screens.md)** (pictures of the actual device. Also program guide, rules, tuner, and settings). ## How it works The components are **tuner agent** (channel selection) and **denpa** (program guide, reservations, recording, encoding, distribution, live viewing) — that's all there is. ```text Tuner ── Agent ── denpa ── Recording(mkv) ─┬─→ Watch directly in the browser └─→… ```

**Ydsz Cloud** is a rapid microservices development platform for enterprise-level applications, built on **Spring Boot 4.0.8**, **Spring Cloud 2025.1.2**, and **Spring Cloud Alibaba 2025.1.0.0**. The platform adopts a **DDD (Domain-Driven Design)** six-layer architecture (`api` / `domain` / `infra` / `server` / `app` / `web`), with **11 core modules** built-in (1 gateway + 9 microservices + 1 code generator + 1 shared dependency library), covering enterprise-level full-business scenarios including user authentication, system management, workflow engine, messaging engine, task engine, rules engine, file storage engine, intelligent engine, and code generation.

racheko-lab/blive-monitor.description: Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + WeChat Push
racheko-lab/blive-monitor.body:
# 📡 Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + Multi-Channel Push

A lightweight live stream status monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms, automatically pushing notifications through multiple channels (Bark / Server Sauce / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram) when going live or releasing new works.

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin live rooms simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-channel Push**: Push notifications through Bark / Server Sauce / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram when going live or releasing new works
- 📊 **Live Duration Statistics**: Record live duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **History Logs**: Keep the last 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Push**: Merge into one notification when multiple streamers go live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Work Detection**: Support for detecting new Douyin work publishing (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitoring Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file and add the streamers you want to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Description:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live room ID
  - Bilibili: Live room number (number in URL, e.g. `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Live room web_rid (string in URL, e.g. `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Streamer name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Live/new work notifications support multiple channels, configured via the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/你的KEY", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or Enterprise WeChat group robot (free and unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or…
```

- Supports DeepSeek Harness (DSH), allowing agents to export conversations as Hammer Notes.
- Support accessing DeepSeek for content polish, grammar and punctuation checking, bold emphasis, simplify complex concepts.
- Support one-click download of Markdown resource packages containing images
- Support download as HTML for offline viewing

## Calling through DSH

You can search for `notes` in DSH's "Plugin Market" to install directly; the source repository comes with pre-compiled products, no need to enable `allowBuilds`. You can also install the npm version via command line:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @zhaoolee/dsh-notes
```

After installation, please restart the target profile to make the plugin take effect. After restart, in DeepSeek Harness conversations say: **Export our conversation as notes**, and the agent will automatically organize the current conversation and call the plugin to generate notes.
